description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.name: Trazyn the Infinite
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with two or more charge counters on it
